sentences.text: Antoni Gaudí was born in Reus in 1852 and became the leading figure of Catalan Modernism.
The Sagrada Família, his unfinished basilica in Barcelona, has been under construction since 1882.
Park Güell showcases Gaudí's playful mosaic technique known as trencadís.
Casa Batlló's undulating facade is said to represent the legend of Saint George and the dragon.
La Pedrera, also called Casa Milà, has no straight walls and was inspired by natural rock formations.
Seven of Gaudí's works are listed as UNESCO World Heritage Sites.
Gaudí never married and had no children.
Casa Vicens was Gaudí's first house.
Gaudí drew inspiration from nature, incorporating organic forms, curved lines, and structural principles found in trees, bones, and honeycombs into his architecture.
Construction of the Sagrada Família has relied entirely on private donations and visitor admission fees rather than government or church funding since it began in 1882.
